regime_context: China A-shares show a narrow two-horse leadership structure (Banks vs Innovative Pharma & CXO) with weak rotation breadth (18% eligible), a leader that is crowded and mixed-trend, and an absolute-trend gate that did_NOT_hold on this market's history — so the detector offers attention/flow texture, not a return forecast, and the risk-management leg is untrusted here.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Banks' breadth (0.889) begins to narrow toward Innovative Pharma & CXO's level (~0.64) while the latter's score closes the 0.01 margin — that observable divergence-overlap would retire the 'two-horse stable' view and suggest a genuine leadership handoff forming.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the top-ranked, eligible theme with the highest durability bar (0.73), near-universal breadth (0.889), and a close challenger margin (0.01) — the flow is concentrating here and the trend is confirmed but not accelerating (mixed Hurst). The crowding flag (z 1.78) is a size-down caution, not a reason to avoid; I hold the direction lightly given the detector's absolute-trend gate has no drawdown-control edge on this mean-reverting tape.
theses.dissent: A late-cycle Financials/Banks trade in a mean-reverting A-share tape frequently whipsaws — the mixed Hurst rating means the banking trend itself is not uniform, and the same 'high durability' breadth could reflect passive income-flow into the theme rather than genuine new leadership.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 benchmark by more than 3% on a total-return basis over the next 20 trading days

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: The challenger theme is a near-tie with the leader (margin 0.01), eligible, with decent durability (0.60) and moderate breadth (0.643). It is the only credible rotational alternative if the Banks flow stalls — but I treat it as an emerging leadership contender, not a confirmed handoff, since the rotation radar itself is display-only and no confirmed handoff has occurred.
evidence: rotation challenger to Banks with margin 0.01
theses.dissent: Pharma/CXO in China carries heavy policy-regulatory risk (VBP pricing, BD/export sensitivity) and the theme is already crowded (z 1.59) at the same time the overall tape mean-reverts — crowding here may mark exhaustion rather than continuation.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ gives up its entire year-to-date outperformance versus the CSI 300 and closes a week below its 20-day average before the end of the check window
